cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before our skating qualifier, can you say the possibility we keep avoiding?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you carrying that onto the ice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'm carrying it already. I just need you to say it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We might not qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why did I need that second sentence so much? Could you name that fear too?

mechanism: A applies old skating debrief prompts to get its former pupil partner to name failure and then feared abandonment before A can.
confusable: Not generic negative prediction: the volunteered reassurance reveals a more vulnerable fear A then asks B to say.
comparison: Financial identity threat versus performance partnership.
seedUse: D104 qualifier/failure/still skate/second fear; S05 old debrief prompting and exact answers.
